From the owner
Arizona’s dry air doesn’t stop a bathroom from filling with steam. If the mirror stays fogged and the ceiling paint starts peeling, the exhaust fan and ductwork deserve a closer look. When we remodel a bathroom, we check how much air the fan moves, where it vents, and how moisture is handled behind the tile. A quiet fan ducted outdoors, a timer or humidity sensor, and proper shower waterproofing are details that deserve attention before the finishes go in. We’ve shared the ventilation and moisture fixes we build into our bathroom remodels, plus the questions to ask before your project starts.
